errors.evidence: The chart is a vertical bar chart, where the bars extend upwards, not a horizontal one.

errors.text_span: mit dem niedrigsten Wert im Jahr 2024 bei etwa 62,9
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies both the year and the value for the lowest point. The chart shows the lowest value is 58.7 in the year 2018. The value 62.9 is explicitly labeled for the year 2022, not 2024.

errors.text_span: Der Wert jedes Jahres ist direkt über jedem Balken angegeben.
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. Only four specific values are labeled above the bars (for years 2010, 2018, 2020, and 2022). The majority of the bars are not labeled with a value.

errors.text_span: Alle Balken sind einheitlich hellblau gehalten
errors.evidence: The bars for the years 2023 and 2024 are a visibly lighter shade of blue than the bars for the years 2000-2022, indicating a visual distinction which the description misses by stating they are uniform.
The description completely omits the prominent horizontal black line drawn across the chart at the 60 mark on the vertical axis.
